question_text: Explain why a database should store birth dates using a suitable date type and an unambiguous input convention, rather than arbitrary text such as 03/04/2010.
adaptation_rationale: Retain date consistency reasoning while replacing form-specific separation with proper database datatype selection. Scenario and wording rewritten; source reasoning retained only within supported 2027 scope.
solution: Ambiguous text may mean3April or 4 March; consistent parsing into a date type gives the same intended date and allows meaningful date comparisons rather than text ordering.

marking_points.criterion: Consistent input parsing/date representation prevents inconsistent interpretations.
Date-aware comparison/validation is preferable to arbitrary text operations.
